in_hebrew.name: Henghold
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Henghold הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Henghold is derived from Old English words ‘hean’ meaning ‘high’ and ‘hold’ meaning ‘keeper’ or ‘protector’. This name was given to children born into noble families, who were expected to uphold their family’s reputation and protect their lands.
